sources.text: There ain’t no mountain high enough and there ain’t no valley deep. Today, you will find yourself on an invincible run. You might be your own worst enemy today if you waste your effort and energy for unproductive purposes. Overall, it is smooth sailing today and Ganesha advises you to stay focussed.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: This is a very spiritual and creative day for you, Taurus. You're especially intuitive. Any creative effort will likely resonate deeply. Even if you don't feel you have the talent for it, why not try some form of artistic expression? You could dabble with a paintbrush or makes notes in a journal. Don't let that pesky internal editor kick in. Create for the sheer joy of it.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: You should feel settled and capable of handling your daily responsibilities, dearest Taurus, as Venus RX and Jupiter align. If you’ve felt behind or like you're constantly playing catch-up, rework your schedule to make more space for downtime. You are reminded that personal balance will impact your clarity, confidence, and stamina while the Scorpio Sun and Mercury RX unite.

readings.text: Today at work, it will be a race against time as the deadlines loom large. You will not take kindly to any form of interference. A helping hand, however, will be welcome. You will be focused and determined to achieve your deadline or target effectively.

You are like the mighty king or queen sitting on the great thrown of power. Hold your chest high and speak with confidence. Your wish will come true so go ahead and make your command. You are the master of your kingdom at this time. Have fun.

readings.text: Ganesha predicts that on the financial front, things will just average today. But, you shall not face any monetary tightness, and you will feel rather comfortable on account of your financial situation.

This week, you have positive and negative news about your financial life. If you've been true to your goals and kept within budget, this planet provides new opportunities to make more money. If you've overspent, sudden and perhaps unexpected changes in your career sector could mean that what you counted on to cover bills may not be there. Saving for the future can get you through this time.

bits.t: Today, you can take your family members out for a get-together and spend a lot of money on them.
Your personality is slightly different from others, and you like to spend time alone.

readings.text: By and large, your health is likely to be good. But, the planetary positions indicate that you may feel less confident. As a result, you might encounter minor hurdles while doing your routine tasks in office and home, says Ganesha.

You may feel frustrated by the judgments that your mind produces. The aspects today invite us to be compassionate with ourselves and others, yet your sign is so dedicated to fairness that you may find it difficult to be compassionate when someone or something is just plain "wrong" in your eyes. Step back and take a break from this kind of situation. Swimming would be recommended now, in order to feel your own weightlessness while you exercise out those frustrations.

bits.t: You might be your own worst enemy today if you waste your effort and energy for unproductive purposes.

lucky.remedy: Feeding spinach to cows will make improve love life in a great way..

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Work hard to keep your eye on the ball today -- major distractions will abound.

astrosage.text: Encourage your mind to be receptive to positive emotions like love hope faith sympathy optimism and loyalty. Once these emotions take complete command-the mind automatically responds positively to every situation. Today, you can take your family members out for a get-together and spend a lot of money on them.  To your surprise brother would come at your rescue. Your need to support and work in close coordination to make eachother's happy. Remember cooperation is the main spring of life Today you will miss true love in your life. Don't worry everything changes with time so will your romantic life. You have the ability to achieve lots- so go after the opportunities that come your way. Your personality is slightly different from others, and you like to spend time alone. Today, you will get time for yourself, but will be occupied by office work.  Your spouse might doubt your loyalty due to your hectic schedule, but the end of the day he/she will understand and give you a hug.
